newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish 9 bln SKR T-bill auction oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Swedish 9 bln SKR T-bill auction oversubscribed.

text.p: Sweden's auction of nine billion crowns worth of Treasury bills in three maturities was heavily oversubscribed, the National Debt Office said on Wednesday.
The average accepted rate in an auction of one billion crowns worth of three month paper was 4.44 percent.
It received 23 bids worth 4.85 billion crowns and accepted nine bids.
An auction of 3.0 billion crowns of six-month paper had an average accepted rate of 4.41 percent after accepting 17 bids from a total of 21 worth 3.27 billion crowns.
The debt office said the average accepted rate on 5.0 billion crowns of one year paper was 4.62 percent.
It received 75 bids worth 8.03 billion crowns of which it accepted 38.
